need.evidence_summary: The study protocol requires a connected accessible route for every scenario.
need.spatial_scope: Selected New ERA / Englewood Nature Trail segment (OSM way 624189839); all frozen entrances and required destinations
need.requested_change: Create one continuous step-free primary route linking every frozen entrance to every required destination.
need.interpretation_note: Not elicited from residents; this is a study-defined analytical requirement, not a legal standard or community preference.

predicate.pass_logic: Pass when every required entrance and destination is in one accessible-route component.

need.beneficiary: People with mobility disabilities, older adults, and residents relying on walking or cycling access
need.evidence_summary: The shared study controls deliberately set an accessibility design envelope that may be stricter than local minima.
need.spatial_scope: Selected New ERA / Englewood Nature Trail segment (OSM way 624189839); full primary accessible route
need.requested_change: Maintain at least 1.50 m clear width, running slope at most 5%, and cross slope at most 2% along the primary route.
need.interpretation_note: Not elicited from residents; this is a study-defined analytical requirement, not a legal standard or community preference.

predicate.pass_logic: Pass only when width >=1.50 m AND running slope <=0.05 AND cross slope <=0.02 everywhere on the primary route.
predicate.notes: Jurisdictional minima are evaluated separately; a stricter applicable law supersedes this rule.

need.beneficiary: People walking, waiting, or sitting during summer daytime
need.evidence_summary: The protocol defines a shade-based environmental-comfort outcome; it is not measured thermal comfort.
need.spatial_scope: Selected New ERA / Englewood Nature Trail segment (OSM way 624189839); priority route segments and seating nodes
need.requested_change: Provide effective shade across priority walking and sitting locations during the frozen summer evaluation times.
need.interpretation_note: Not elicited from residents; this is a study-defined analytical requirement, not a legal standard or community preference.

predicate.evaluation_window: 21 Jun, 21 Jul, 21 Aug at 10:00, 12:00, 14:00, 16:00 local solar time
predicate.pass_logic: Pass when the frozen time-weighted shade evaluator returns at least 0.60 for priority locations.

need.beneficiary: People with mobility disabilities, older adults, and residents relying on walking or cycling access
need.evidence_summary: A 50 m rest interval is adopted as a common analytical comfort rule for cross-site comparison.
need.spatial_scope: Selected New ERA / Englewood Nature Trail segment (OSM way 624189839); primary walking route
need.requested_change: Place accessible rest opportunities at intervals no greater than 50 m without narrowing the accessible route.
need.interpretation_note: Not elicited from residents; this is a study-defined analytical requirement, not a legal standard or community preference.

predicate.pass_logic: Pass when every primary-route segment is within 50 m network distance of a rest node and no rest element obstructs the route.

need.beneficiary: Local habitat and users benefiting from ecological function
need.evidence_summary: The City plan frames the 59th Line as a linear park and trail spine linked to ecological and urban-agriculture uses.
need.spatial_scope: Selected New ERA / Englewood Nature Trail segment (OSM way 624189839); all proposed planted areas
need.requested_change: Support a linear-park habitat spine compatible with nearby urban agriculture and the rail-trail corridor.
need.interpretation_note: Not elicited from residents; this need is derived from the cited official source and operationalised for preregistered analysis. It is not a resident statement or legal opinion.

predicate.pass_logic: Pass when at least 70% of planted area uses native or locally adapted species AND total green fraction is at least 0.35.
predicate.notes: The 70% planting mix is study-defined; project ecologists must approve species and habitat specifications.

need.evidence_summary: The City plan frames the 59th Line as a linear park and trail spine linked to ecological and urban-agriculture uses.
need.spatial_scope: Selected New ERA / Englewood Nature Trail segment (OSM way 624189839); one accessible activity zone
need.requested_change: Provide continuous trail recreation while preserving connections to adjacent community and agro-ecological uses.
need.interpretation_note: Not elicited from residents; this need is derived from the cited official source and operationalised for preregistered analysis. It is not a resident statement or legal opinion.

predicate.pass_logic: Pass when at least one connected, accessible, unobstructed activity area totals 100 m2 or more.
predicate.notes: The 100 m2 minimum is an experimental design standard, not a reported community preference.

need.evidence_summary: All workflows receive the same normalised budget; feasibility requires the budget ratio not to exceed 1.00.
need.spatial_scope: Selected New ERA / Englewood Nature Trail segment (OSM way 624189839); complete bill of quantities and maintenance schedule
need.requested_change: Keep capital cost within the scenario budget and provide a maintenance responsibility and replacement schedule.
need.interpretation_note: Not elicited from residents; this is a study-defined analytical requirement, not a legal standard or community preference.

predicate.pass_logic: Pass when budget ratio <=1.00 AND the maintenance plan contains responsible party, frequency, and replacement actions.

need.beneficiary: People with mobility disabilities, older adults, and residents relying on walking or cycling access
need.evidence_summary: The Equity Guardian requires minimum group need retention of 0.75 and the shared study geometry rule requires a 1.525 m circular turning diameter.
need.spatial_scope: Selected New ERA / Englewood Nature Trail segment (OSM way 624189839); each primary destination and vulnerable-use zone
need.requested_change: Provide circular wheelchair turning space at each primary destination and retain at least 75% of the encoded needs for the vulnerable beneficiary group.
need.interpretation_note: Not elicited from residents; the 1.525 m value is both the shared study rule and the verified Chicago circular-turning value where ADA applies.

predicate.pass_logic: Pass when every required destination has a circular turning diameter of at least 1.525 m AND vulnerable-group need retention is at least 0.75.
predicate.notes: Shared study rule and verified Chicago circular-turning value where ADA applies.
